title: Triage heatlist — solo ad-hoc analysis
description: One-sheet ad-hoc tracker used to triage and annotate small cross-functional asks during a short outage window. Lightweight owner assignment, quick next-steps, and ETA expectations. Informal notes + TODOs included.

raw_notes: - This is intentionally minimal: one row per atomic action. Keep rows terse.
- Use priority P0..P3 where P0 needs immediate action in next 60m.
- When resolving, append resolution timestamp and short cause (eg: config revert, policy update).
- Should we auto-assign fallback ownership to on-call SRE when route fallback is missing? pros/cons listed inline above.
- Do we want a separate 'long-running' tracker for items that go beyond 48h? (I think yes; this sheet becomes noisy after 2 days)
- If you don't have an owner, ping #ops-rotations and mark row as 'Unassigned'.
- Keep a copy of the final snapshot in Confluence before closing the week.
